seo.title: Architecture | openIndu Full-Stack Platform
seo.description: Understand openIndu's complete industrial automation stack: from domestic industrial SoCs to craftsmanship knowledge. An end-to-end solution for manufacturing.

hero.title: The openIndu Full-Chain Architecture
hero.subtitle: From industrial silicon to craftsmanship knowledge — one chain across the whole manufacturing flow
hero.formula: Domestic industrial SoC + openEuler + openIndu-studio + three application layers + craftsmanship knowledge = a complete industrial automation OS

craftsmanship.title: Craftsmanship Knowledge Layer
craftsmanship.description: Forum process columns: end-to-end chains, shop-floor practice and defect reasoning for panels, semiconductors, new energy and more

application.title: Application Layer
application.description: Three directions working together: machine-vision inspection, edge data acquisition, and IIoT platform analytics

programming.title: Programming & Configuration Layer
programming.description: openIndu-studio: PLC programming, HMI configuration, PLC selection, BOM, circuit diagrams and cross-brand code generation

hardware.title: Hardware & OS Layer
hardware.description: Domestic industrial SoC + the openEuler operating system: real-time control, industrial protocols, local edge decisions

interaction.heading: How the Layers Work Together
interaction.flowStep1: Design the PLC logic, HMI screens and PLC selection once, inside openIndu-studio
interaction.flowStep2: Automatically emit cross-brand code for Siemens S7, Mitsubishi, Omron and others — plus BOM and circuit diagrams
interaction.flowStep3: Deploy to a soft PLC on domestic silicon, or to the target hardware PLC
interaction.appsLeft: OpenCV-based inspection and positioning, fed back to the PLC
interaction.appsCore: Runs the PLC logic, consumes vision results, drives the actuators
interaction.appsRight: Collects everything and reports it to the IIoT platform for analysis
interaction.loop: Live data → platform analysis → process bottleneck found → solution shared in the forum's process column → parameters tuned → yield improves

rows.openindu: Design once → generate code for every brand

rows.traditional: Vision and IIoT each on their own → data silos
rows.openindu: Three application layers in concert → a data-driven loop

rows.traditional: Every company works it out alone
rows.openindu: A crowdsourced forum library → the industry improves together

rows.traditional: Tied to a proprietary platform → costly upgrades
